output.summary: The backlog growth is mostly self-generated by the per-agent close quota, not by demand or effort. First-contact demand rose only 4%. Split children rose from 240 to 3,710 and duplicates from 410 to 2,770. The reopen rate rose from 6% to 23%. Closes per agent day rose from 11.7 to 19.0, so effort is not the problem. Agents moved from oldest-first picking to a quick-wins filter, and aged complex tickets tripled. A lead and the anonymous survey both describe gaming. The evidence supports suspending the quota and measuring quality (A3). It also supports classifying the aged complex tickets (A4). Raising the quota is harmful. Hiring 12 agents now is premature. The role of Engineering bugs and attrition causes remains unestablished.
